text:
ana_sales: Heads-up — carrier customer (large telco) is moving to POC. They need strict EU-only processing, per-tenant region pinning, and BYOK for keys. Asking about subprocessors list, routing fallthrough, and any extra egress charges. Can we brief?

mika_solutions: Thanks. Do they want a dedicated tenant pin or per-request geofence?

customer_it: Per-tenant pin required. Must guarantee traffic stays in EU regions and never leaves to US/ASIA. Also need a list of subprocessors for SOC review.

ana_sales: (typo) meant to say @customer_it. Got it. Rajesh, any blocking infra limitations for pinning tenants to EU-only workers?

rajesh_eng: Short answer: supported. We can pin tenant routing to EU control plane + EU inference pool. Two caveats: 1) fallback behavior if EU capacity saturated; 2) BYOK key management integration timeline.

mika_solutions: For capacity fallback, can we expose a policy toggle to forbid cross-region failover? Customer insists on "never-cross-border" mode.

rajesh_eng: We already have routing policy flags but default includes fallback to nearest compatible region. We can add a stricter mode (no-failover) — needs product + infra toggle. Est 2 sprints for QA if prioritized.

elaine_legal: Also will need subprocessors list with data residency attestations. We can provide current cloud infra providers and managed monitoring vendors; any third-party inference accelerators?

rajesh_eng: No third-party inference accelerators in the POC config — it's Redwood-managed pools on GCP (europe-west6) + optional dedicated nodes in customer VPC. Subprocessors are: GCP, our monitoring vendor (MonSight), and keywrap provider (KeySafe).

mika_solutions: Customer asked about KMS: they want BYOK with key material in their KMS and control over key rotation. What integration surface do we expose?

rajesh_eng: Two options: 1) Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) with envelope encryption — we store only wrapped keys; 2) HSM-backed customer key via private deployment. For hosted POC, option 1 is fastest. We need their KMS public key and IAM policy.

customer_it: For the POC hosted route we prefer BYOK with envelope keys. We can provide GCP KMS key and service account binding. Also want to confirm logs containing user prompts won't leave EU.

ana_sales: (again typo) ana_sales: We'll put that in the SOW. Rajesh — can you confirm where logs and audit trails live by default?

rajesh_eng: Audit logs can be configured per-deployment. Hosted API by default centralizes ops logs in our control plane (currently in eu-west). We can enable EU-only storage for audit/log retention for the tenant — still needs legal signoff due to replication backups.

elaine_legal: I'll prepare subprocessors CSV + attestation snippets. Also need to confirm retention windows and deletion processes for the POC.

mika_solutions: Customer asked about pricing implications of strict region pinning + no-failover. Any delta on committed capacity or egress?

rajesh_eng: Two cost levers: 1) Reserving EU-only capacity (dedicated pool) increases base commit; 2) No-failover reduces our ability to opportunistically place on cheaper spare capacity — so per-token unit cost may be ~10-25% higher depending on utilization. Egress: if traffic stays in EU there is no cross-border egress, but intra-EU egress still billed by cloud provider.

ana_sales: Can you give a rough quote range for the POC? They want a 3-week trial with up to 10M tokens.

mika_solutions: I'll draft a short pricing calc: base reserved node (x) + overage per-token (y) + BYOK integration flat fee. Need numbers from finance.

elaine_legal: Also add clause: no automatic cross-border failover during POC. We'll need an exception process for emergency (on-call) that requires written approval.

rajesh_eng: Ops action items: 1) create routing policy `eu_strict_no_failover`; 2) verify audit logs retention in eu-west config; 3) confirm wrapped key flow with customer's KMS. I'll make a short checklist.

rajesh_eng: Checklist snippet:
```
- create tenant routing profile: eu_strict_no_failover
- reserve 2 dedicated GPU slots in europe-west6 for POC
- enable audit storage EU-only, retention 30d
- request customer's KMS public key + service account
- disable cross-region fallback in control plane for tenant
```

mika_solutions: Can we get ops estimate for ETA? Customer wants kickoff Mon next week.

rajesh_eng: If we start tomorrow: infra changes + reservations = 3 business days, BYOK integration + testing = 4 business days, legal + SOW = parallel. Overall ~8 business days.

ana_sales: I'll schedule kickoff and share SOW draft. Elaine, please attach subprocessors CSV and sample attestation.

elaine_legal: On it. I'll add note about backups — we can commit to EU-only backups for the POC window.

customer_it: Great — appreciate the timeline. One last: can you confirm whether edge inference endpoints (for latency) will still route through EU region even if customer users worldwide connect? We need guarantee that inference compute remains in EU even if client is global.

rajesh_eng: Yes — with `eu_strict_no_failover` compute and KV caches will remain in EU. We will still accept HTTPS requests at global LB, but payloads will be forwarded to EU worker pool; no model/context data will leave region.

mika_solutions: I'll summarize and post a short SOW checklist into the thread later. :+1:

ana_sales: Thanks team — will ping if the customer has additional compliance asks.
